title: Hands outside: the hat clock
note: The clock from the hats, unchanged, centred on its ring and as big as a circle allows: the minute hand reaches the rim, so the ring is about a third of the tile. With the hands outside at their length, it can never be bigger.

title: Hands run off the edge
note: Same drawing, bigger: the ring is half the tile and the hands run off the top and the bottom right, so the frame crops their tips. The clock itself never changes.

title: Square version: shorter hands
note: Its own drawing for squares, like the side-of-hat master: the same clock with the hands about a third shorter, so the whole clock fits and the ring is bigger.

title: Clock face
note: The ring becomes the dial and the hands sit inside it, standing out of the pivot dot across the same gap they keep from the ring now. Fills the square and reads as a clock at 5:00 at any size.

title: Stacked name
note: OFF over SHFT with the clock O, the way the name fills a square. Says the name in avatars while nobody knows the symbol yet; the clock itself is small.
